--- finder files and folders
on t(p)
    tell application "Finder"
        set f to folder p
        set a to name of every file of f
        set b to every folder of f
        set c to (every file of f whose name extension = "txt") as alias list
        set d to count every item of f
        set e to exists file "a.txt" of f
        set g to container of f as text
        return {a, b, c, d, e, g, kind of f, size of f, modification date of f, name extension of file 1 of f, displayed name of f}
    end tell
end t
--- finder make and move
on t(p)
    tell application "Finder"
        if not (exists folder "out" of folder p) then
            make new folder at folder p with properties {name:"out"}
        end if
        set dest to folder "out" of folder p
        repeat with f in (get every file of folder p)
            if {"jpg", "png"} contains name extension of f then
                move f to dest with replacing
            else if size of f > 1000000 then
                duplicate f to dest
            else
                set label index of f to 2
            end if
        end repeat
        return count every file of dest
    end tell
end t
--- finder windows
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        activate
        set w to make new Finder window
        set target of w to home
        set current view of w to list view
        set bounds of w to {10, 10, 500, 400}
        set toolbar visible of w to false
        set {x, y} to position of w
        close every window
        return {x, y, name of w, index of w, (count every window)}
    end tell
end t
--- finder selection
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        set sel to selection
        if sel = {} then
            return 0
        end if
        set n to 0
        repeat with i in sel
            if class of i = folder then
                set n to n + (count every item of i)
            else
                set n to n + 1
            end if
        end repeat
        return {n, name of item 1 of sel, item 1 of sel as alias, selection as alias list}
    end tell
end t
--- finder insertion locations
on t(p)
    tell application "Finder"
        make new folder at end of folder p
        make new folder at beginning of folder p with properties {name:"a"}
        make new alias file at desktop to folder p
        move file "a" of folder p to end of folder "b" of folder p
        duplicate file "a" of folder p to beginning of folder "b" of folder p
        move file "a" of desktop to trash
    end tell
end t
--- finder nested tell and its
on t(p)
    tell application "Finder"
        tell folder p
            set a to name
            set b to name
            set c to name
            set d to count every file
            set e to name of every file
            tell file 1
                set f to name
                set g to size
                set h to name of its container
            end tell
        end tell
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}
end t
--- system events processes
on t()
    tell application "System Events"
        set a to name of every process
        set b to name of process 1 whose frontmost = true
        set c to count (every process whose background only = false)
        set d to exists process "Finder"
        set e to unix id of process "Finder"
        set f to bundle identifier of process "Finder"
        return {a, b, c, d, e, f}
    end tell
end t
--- system events ui scripting
on t(appName)
    tell application "System Events"
        tell process appName
            set frontmost to true
            click menu item "New" of menu "File" of menu bar 1
            click menu item 2 of menu 1 of menu bar item "Edit" of menu bar 1
            keystroke "a" using {command down}
            key code 53
            set v to value of text field 1 of window 1
            set value of text field 1 of window 1 to "x"
            click button "OK" of window 1
            set n to count every window
            if (exists sheet 1 of window 1) then
                click button 1 of sheet 1 of window 1
            end if
            return {v, n, name of window 1, position of window 1, size of window 1, role of UI element 1 of window 1}
        end tell
    end tell
end t
--- system events files
on t(p)
    tell application "System Events"
        set a to exists file p
        set b to exists folder p
        set c to name of every file of folder p
        set d to size of file p
        set e to POSIX path of file p
        set f to name of disk item p
        set g to path of home folder
        set h to name of current user
        return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h}
    end tell
end t
--- system events property list
on t(p)
    tell application "System Events"
        set pl to property list file p
        set v to value of property list item "key" of pl
        set value of property list item "key" of pl to "new"
        set names to name of every property list item of pl
        return {v, names}
    end tell
end t
--- system events keystroke sequences
on t(s)
    tell application "System Events"
        keystroke s
        keystroke return
        keystroke tab
        keystroke "v" using command down
        keystroke "z" using {command down, shift down}
        key code 36 using {control down, option down}
        key down shift
        key up shift
        delay 0.2
    end tell
end t
--- two applications in one handler
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        set a to name of startup disk
    end tell
    tell application "System Events"
        set b to name of current user
    end tell
    tell application "Finder"
        set c to name of home
        tell application "System Events"
            set d to count every process
        end tell
        set e to count every window
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e}
end t
--- application properties
on t(n)
    tell application n
        set a to name
        set b to version
        set c to frontmost
        set d to id
        set e to running
        return {a, b, c, d, e}
    end tell
end t
--- application by variable with terms
on t(n)
    using terms from application "Finder"
        tell application n
            return name of startup disk
        end tell
    end using terms from
end t
--- tell with return in the middle and after
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        if (count every window) = 0 then
            return "none"
        end if
        set n to name of window 1
    end tell
    return n
end t
--- tell with try and timeout
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        try
            with timeout of 5 seconds
                set n to name of startup disk
            end timeout
        on error msg
            set n to msg
        end try
    end tell
    return n
end t
--- ignoring responses around tell
on t()
    ignoring application responses
        tell application "Finder"
            activate
            open home
        end tell
    end ignoring
    tell application "Finder"
        return name of home
    end tell
end t
--- standard additions inside tell
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        set p to (path to desktop folder) as text
        display dialog "x" buttons {"OK"} default button 1
        set d to current date
        set r to do shell script "true"
        beep
        delay 1
        set n to name of folder p
    end tell
    return {p, d, r, n}
end t
--- finder labels and comments
on t(f)
    tell application "Finder"
        set comment of f to "c"
        set label index of f to 3
        set locked of f to false
        set name of f to "n"
        set extension hidden of f to true
        return {comment of f, label index of f, locked of f, creation date of f, physical size of f, owner of f}
    end tell
end t
--- finder desktop positions
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        set l to {}
        repeat with i from 1 to (count every item of desktop)
            set end of l to {name of item i of desktop, desktop position of item i of desktop}
        end repeat
        return {l, bounds of window of desktop, name of startup disk, free space of startup disk, capacity of startup disk}
    end tell
end t
--- every with ranges in app
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        return {items 1 thru 2 of desktop, name of items 1 thru -1 of desktop, files 2 thru 3 of home, item 1 of desktop, item -1 of desktop, item -2 of desktop, some item of desktop, middle item of desktop, every item of desktop, name of every item of desktop}
    end tell
end t
--- capital name that is a word of an application
on t(|Subject|)
    tell application "Mail"
        set x to |Subject|
    end tell
    return {x, |Subject|}
end t
